market.question: Will the highest temperature in Buenos Aires be 19°C on May 3?

assessment.reasoning: Buenos Aires Ezeiza early-May average highs ~18.6C with daily range 14-23C. 19C bucket is near the median; competing buckets (17,18,20) split the mass.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Day-to-day variability in autumnal southern-hemisphere weather.
